cutoff_accrual_control.control_conclusion: Invoice 88417 reports $46,800 of gross release billings less $13,003.31 of prior billings, leaving $33,796.69 currently due. The current invoice is absent from the June posted populations, but its prior draw remains inside the PM snapshot's gross $46,800 forecast amount. Gross June work is $40,200 and the July 2 line is $6,600, so only the unbilled $27,196.69 June portion requires a separate accrual. Remove both the stale $13,003.31 prior-billing duplicate and the $27,196.69 current transfer from ETC, leaving the $6,600 July line there. CCS-CM-0629-17 is also absent from the June ledger and conditionally applies $27,000 against previously billed work. The agreement makes delivery to ARM Commercial Records an operative condition, and the receipt stamp is July 2, so no credit component is recognized in the June close.
